newsitem.title: GERMANY: German cocoa trader sees processor buying.
newsitem.headline: German cocoa trader sees processor buying.

text.p: German chocolate manufacturers appeared on the cocoa bean market in response to futures falls and a lower sterling against the mark, trader Albrecht & Dill GmbH (A&D) said in a weekly report on Friday.
A&D said the Ivory Coast, which opened its 1996/97 cocoa season on Thursday, was mostly behind the origin sales.
European differentials were easing, with good fermented Ivorian cocoa (afloat) offered at up to 40 stg under London December, A&D noted.
